finding.title: Shared success envelope required a payload absent from valid action acknowledgements
finding.trigger: Model a ResponseHelper success without data or consume a typed general ApiEnvelope as if its payload were guaranteed.
finding.actual: ApiSuccess required data, rejecting valid backend action replies. unwrap returned T even though those replies yield undefined at runtime.
finding.evidence: Actual admin invitation revoke controller sends ResponseHelper.ok without data, with actionSuccessResponse on its route. Synthetic Fastify tests exercise that same helper/schema contract, not the full authenticated invitation endpoint.

diagnostics: TS2741 missing data in valid ApiSuccess<void>
TS2322 backend optional-data SuccessResponse incompatible with shared ApiSuccess
Two TS2578 unused negative assertions demonstrate unchecked payload access was permitted
compiler_baseline.fixture_repair: Initial root attempt also exposed a misplaced expected-error directive for a nested details property. Moved it directly above the property before capturing the four-diagnostic focused compiler baseline. The initial output remains local historical evidence.
compiler_baseline.program: Focused fixture under inherited root strict compiler options; later full root compilation passes.

finding.correction: ApiSuccess.data is optional. unwrap overloads retain T for an input explicitly requiring data and otherwise return T | undefined. Runtime implementation is unchanged.

review.dependency_scope: Read shared HTTP helper/error/schema implementation, API client implementation/configuration, shared compiler presets and representative actual frontend consumers. Trace the real invitation acknowledgement path and existing generated DTO consumer type checks. No full frontend, authentication, endpoint or generated-SDK audit implied.
review.contracts: Compile-only positive/negative checks cover success/error discrimination, missing payload safety, required-payload precision, Result branch narrowing, null/undefined aliases, plain string wire IDs/dates, pagination equality and error-details compatibility with backend definitions.
review.duplication_decision: Domain and wire pagination represent separate boundaries; retain independent declarations and check exact structural compatibility with the compiler. Avoid introducing a core/domain dependency into a source-only wire package. No duplicate runtime logic exists in the type-only file.
review.configuration: Private package exports its TypeScript source. noEmit true overrides the shared library emit preset; source-only package type check and API-client resolution pass. Tests are checked by the root program rather than included under the package src rootDir. Manifest/config formatting was normalized without Git content changes.
review.coverage: No executable application logic in packages/types: use compiler and wire-boundary verification rather than an artificial runtime coverage percentage.

checks.focused_contract_tsc: passed after four meaningful baseline diagnostics
checks.admin_tsc: passed before and after, no application changes
checks.storefront_tsc: passed before and after, no application changes
checks.focused_eslint: passed for shared type/client sources and both fixtures
checks.focused_prettier: passed for entire types package and changed client source

verification.runtime_cases: Four payload-free acknowledgements (ok/created/command/query), six payloads (0/false/empty string/null/empty array/object), three error cases (field/root/server), one empty 204 response; actual Fastify helpers, action schema and client unwrap. Instances closed in finally; fetch retry suite uses inert stubs.
commands: Vitest types wire tests plus API-client retry tests and shared-foundation unit tests
Full default Vitest unit subset excluding test/integration and test/e2e
Focused ESLint; Prettier for packages/types and packages/api-client/src/index.ts
verification.coverage: Not remeasured; both production files emit identical JavaScript with ES2022/ESNext and comments removed. Broad backend coverage remains historical.

limits: Type declarations and overloads do not validate unknown JSON. any, assertions or incorrect endpoint types can still hide absent payloads; existing fetchers parse JSON as any. Owning frontend/network-boundary validation remains P14 work.

The storefront uses a separate request engine that unwraps already extracted payloads and returns {} as T for empty/204 bodies. It is not interchangeable with the SDK envelope unwrap; no consolidation or frontend behavior migration was made.
UUID and ISODateString remain plain wire strings, distinct from nominal domain ID classes. Runtime shape/date/UUID validation is handled in the validation/HTTP owning reviews.

Shared shape compatibility does not certify every endpoint schema/DTO, generated SDK freshness, role/ownership checks or all frontend flows. API-client source remains open for full SDK/auth-refresh review later in P01.
HTTP field-detail policy and event composition remain open in the planned shared-host review. P15 build/bootstrap/provider checks remain required.
No DB/provider rerun or frontend production build. Prior PostgreSQL 47-group evidence is historical; no persisted data, schema, dependency or runtime behavior changed.
